justification: Inspected `src/main/java/org/jsoup/safety/Safelist.java` and searched `src/main/java` and `src/test/java` for `TypedValue`. The class is an abstract nested value wrapper (lines 641-666) with only one field and trivial `Validate.notNull`, `Objects.equals/hashCode`, `toString` behavior. Its only incoming uses are the four inner subclasses in the same file (`TagName`, `AttributeKey`, `AttributeValue`, `Protocol` at lines 601-639); there are no external references to `TypedValue` and no evidence of many distinct classes depending on it. This is low fan-in/low fan-out, not a hub-like dependency center.
